Cracked crab claws with garlic butter.How to make it1kg cooked crab claws100g butter3 garlic cloves, crushed1/2 tsp chilli flakes2 tbsp parsley, chopped2 lemons1 baguetteCrack the claws with the back of a heavy knife so the shell opens.Melt the butter with the garlic and chilli until fragrant.Steam or warm the claws in a covered pan with a splash of water.Pour over the garlic butter, scatter with parsley and serve with lemon and bread.Buenos Aires beef empanadasRico is from Buenos Aires. Golden beef empanadas with chimichurri.How to make it400g beef mince1 brown onion, diced1 red capsicum, diced2 tsp sweet paprika1 tsp ground cumin2 hard-boiled eggs, chopped1/2 cup green olives, chopped3 sheets of frozen shortcrust pastry1 egg, beaten1 cup parsley leaves2 tbsp red wine vinegar80ml olive oilBrown the mince, add the onion, capsicum and spices and cook until soft, then cool and fold in the eggs and olives.Cut 12cm rounds from the pastry, fill, fold and crimp the edges.Brush with egg and bake at 200°C until golden.Chop the parsley with a pinch of salt and stir in the vinegar and oil for chimichurri.Salted potato chipsWould you like to know more? Ask for a refill.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Front pageCaptured Brain Bug roast cauliflowerZim captures the Brain Bug. Whole roast cauliflower, tahini and pomegranate.How to make it1 large whole cauliflower, leaves trimmed4 tbsp olive oil2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp ground cumin80g tahini1 lemon1 garlic clove, crushed1/2 pomegranate, seeds only1/2 cup mint leaves300g couscousBoil the whole cauliflower for 6 minutes, then drain and dry.Rub with the oil, paprika, cumin and salt and roast at 220°C until deep golden.Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, garlic and enough water to pour.Pour boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.Pour the tahini over the cauliflower, scatter with pomegranate and mint and carve at the table.Roughnecks beer-braised short ribsCome on you apes, live forever. Sticky short ribs, mash and charred onions.How to make it1.6kg beef short ribs2 brown onions, cut in wedges375ml dark lager250ml beef stock2 tbsp tomato paste2 tbsp brown sugar1kg floury potatoes60g butter125ml milkBrown the ribs well in a heavy pot, then lift out and colour the onions.Add the beer, stock, tomato paste and sugar, return the ribs, cover and braise at 160°C.Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and milk.Reduce the braising liquid to a glaze and spoon it over the ribs to serve with the mash.Sweet stuffService Guarantees Citizenship alfajoresService guarantees citizenship. Dulce de leche sandwich biscuits in coconut.How to make it100g butter, softened80g caster sugar2 egg yolks150g cornflour100g plain flour1 tsp baking powder1 tsp lemon zest380g tin caramel (dulce de leche)40g desiccated coconutBeat the butter and sugar, then the yolks and zest, and mix in the flours and baking powder to a soft dough.Roll 5mm thick, cut 5cm rounds and bake at 170°C until pale and set.Cool, sandwich pairs with a thick layer of caramel and roll the edges in coconut.Late extraHere's the beer keg lagerHere's the beer, says Rasczak.
